capabilities.description: Shape ABI metadata provided by the dsh-shape runtime itself.
capabilities.usage: Read apiVersion to branch on the shape ABI. Version 1 is the current ABI; no methods are exposed.

capabilities.description: Navigate between DSH workspaces in registry order.
capabilities.usage: Call next() or previous() to switch with wrap-around. list() returns { id, title } entries and current() returns the active workspace id or null. Switching opens the target workspace's most recent Session, or its blank Session when none exists, then expands and scrolls that workspace group into view in the sidebar.

capabilities.description: Control the DSH surface: navigate Sessions and Workspaces, toggle panels, read and switch the theme, send or cancel turns, show toasts, and open the shape browser.
capabilities.usage: openSession(id) and openWorkspace(id) navigate; toggleSidebar() and selectPanel(id|null) move the layout; getTheme() returns { id, preference } and setTheme(id) switches it; send(text) and cancelTurn() act on the scoped Session; notify(text, { tone, timeout }) shows a toast; openShapeBrowser() raises the shape browser. Methods throw when the host lacks the underlying service.

capabilities.description: Register DSH keyboard commands that users can rebind, so shape actions appear in the shortcut settings and reference.
capabilities.usage: register({ id, label, aliases, keys, run }) registers one command as shape:<shapeId>:<id>; keys is a combination such as "Ctrl+Alt+M" (Ctrl/Alt/Shift/Meta/Mod plus a letter, digit, F-key, or named key), and omitting it leaves the command unbound. list() returns this shape's catalog rows with keys, modified, conflicts, and issue. Registration throws on duplicate ids and overlapping defaults.

capabilities.description: Discover the conversation slots this host renders, mount into them, and count the mounts a shape owns.
capabilities.usage: list() returns every supported slot with its presentation, whether this host renders it, and how many mounts this shape and all shapes own. mount(slot, render, options) renders into a slot and returns a disposer; options.placement is anchored (default) or floating for conversation.input.overlay, and options.snap defaults to true. entries(slot) returns how many mounts this shape owns in that slot.

capabilities.description: Publish and subscribe to events shared by every running shape.
capabilities.usage: emit(type, payload) publishes to every subscriber; on(type, handler) subscribes and returns an unsubscribe function. Names are plain strings namespaced by convention, for example "mcp-manager/servers-changed". Handler failures are contained and logged. A shape's subscriptions are released when it is disabled or reloaded.

capabilities.description: Persist JSON values in the shape's own data/ directory.
capabilities.usage: get(key) returns the stored value or null; set(key, value) writes JSON; remove(key) deletes; keys() lists stored keys. Keys match [a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{0,63} and each value is limited to 256 KB. Files live under the shape directory as data/<key>.json; bundled shapes are read-only.

capabilities.description: Read and write the active composer draft.
capabilities.usage: getText() returns the draft, setText(text) replaces it, insert(text) adds text at the caret, submit() sends it, and sessionId() names the attached Session. The API follows the composer currently mounted in the conversation; calls throw when no composer is mounted.

capabilities.description: Read the rendered conversation and reveal a message.
capabilities.usage: messages() lists the rendered rows with { id, turn, text }; find(text, { caseSensitive, limit }) returns { messageId, index, preview } matches; reveal(messageId) scrolls that row into view; subscribe(listener) reports transcript changes. Only loaded turns are readable — older history appears after the conversation loads it.
